name: codex-grok-video-pipeline
description: Generate, download, verify, and hand off Grok Imagine videos from Codex using a local SuperGrok OAuth bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Run Grok Imagine video jobs end to end from Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native workflow for text-to-video and image-to-video generation through a local xAI OAuth bridge, including polling, MP4 download, metadata retention, media verification, and safe handoff to editing workflows.
interface.defaultPrompt: Generate a Grok Imagine video, download it locally, verify the MP4, and return the output and metadata paths.
